dedupe_keys.name: statistics lithuania population and housing census 2001 2011 and 2021 conventional dwellings by amenities electricity water supply sewerage hot water flush toilet bath and floor area by municipality sdmx api

description: Statistics Lithuania publishes its census results in the official statistics portal, whose SDMX REST API lists 9,503 dataflows and returns data without registration. The census dataflows, with structure codes GBS03xxxx, count conventional dwellings and those with electricity supply, water supply, sewerage, hot water supply, a flush toilet, a bath or shower, or all conveniences, for 2001 and 2011 in one set of flows and for 2021 in another. Each flow is split by administrative territory, urban or rural place of residence and dwelling type (single dwelling, two dwelling or multi dwelling building, or non residential building); a separate flow gives dwellings by useful floor area. Coverage is national: for 2021 the API returned 1,437,680 conventional dwellings and 1,420,401 conventional dwellings with sewerage. Format and access: free SDMX XML and JSON through the REST API. The portal web pages returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) from the cloud, so the tables could only be read through the API. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: territory codes need the codelist from the data structure definition; the definition of sewerage was not read. Simulation uses: municipal counts of dwellings on water, sewer and electricity networks by building type for capacity planning, and floor area for exposure. Related records: the Estonia REL2021 dwelling amenities tables and the Hungary census 2022 dwelling series.
